newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico soft-drink firms initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico soft-drink firms initiated.

text.p: Mexico's Interacciones brokerage on Tuesday initiated coverage of five Mexican soft-drink companies.
-- Interacciones beverage analyst Gregory Rianhard also updated coverage on Embotelladores del Valle de Anahuac SA de CV (Emvasa), maintaining a rating of speculative buy.

-- Coca-Cola Femsa was started with a hold recommendation. Interacciones said KOF was a "blue-chip holding" but was given a hold rating "because of relatively low appreciation potential in the near term." Shares down 2.20 pesos to 39.60 pesos in early afternoon trade.

-- Pepsi-Gemex was started with a speculative buy recommendation. Rianhard called the company "one of the strongest Pepsi bottlers in the world, with market share ahead of Pepsi's global average," but noted the possibility of "continued loss of market-share leads." Up 20 centavos to 22 pesos.

-- Grupo Continental (Contal) was started with a buy recommendation as "the most profitable Coca-Cola bottler in Mexico, largely due to its sugar refining business and very strong market share in its territories." Up 70 centavos to 21.65 pesos.

-- Sistema Argos was started with a buy recommendation as "arguably the most successful bottler in Mexico as it boasts greater market share than its notably strong fellow Coca-Cola bottlers." Up 64 centavos to 13.50 pesos.

-- Grupo Embotelladores Unidas (Geupec) was initiated with a sell recommendation. "Geupec's performance has been among the worst in recent years," Rianhard said of one of Mexico's smaller publicly traded bottlers. Down 70 centavos to 22.90 pesos.
--Emvasa shares were down 12 centavos to 7.24 pesos.
